Requirements:
1. The trip must last 3 days.
2. The plan must be for 2 travelers.
3. Tickets for attractions, intercity transport, and metro rides must match 2 travelers.
4. Satisfy at least one of these two requirements (both are allowed): (A) Keep the total duration of all in-city transport segments within 573 minutes. (B) Each accommodation stay must use twin-bed rooms.
5. Keep all activity and transportation costs on day 3 within 1456 CNY.
6. Use metro as the primary mode for exactly 14 in-city journeys.
7. Visit exactly 3 attractions on day 3.
8. Keep the total walking distance within 22.8 kilometers.
9. Do not include any of these hotel feature types: Robot Service and Sauna.
10. Visit the following attractions: Sun Yat-sen University (South Campus) and Xinghai Concert Hall.
11. Stay at exactly 1 different hotel.
12. Stay at Atour X Hotel, Wanbo Center, Guangzhou before visiting Xinghai Concert Hall.
13. Day 2 must include breakfast and lunch.
